description: This file defines a Java interface for a live command that modifies a feature property within a system. It provides methods to access the JSON pointer of the property to modify and its new value, serving as a component in a larger command execution framework within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command that modifies a feature property, providing access to the property identifier and value.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating which property to modify.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the new value for the property to be set.
